background_scenario_basis: report date defines the retrospective plan day; release is no earlier than observed order time; report time, room and doctor are excluded
bladder_readiness_rule: max(plan-day start, order time plus preparation) for background; order time plus preparation for inpatient

doctor_capacity.method: weekday-by-5-minute median of training-day active session proxy
doctor_capacity.session_reconstruction: first activity at 07:00-09:00 snaps to 08:00; 12:30-14:00 snaps to 13:00; last activity at 11:00-12:30 snaps to 12:00 and 16:00-19:00 snaps to 17:00; otherwise retain observed interval with a 10-minute start expansion

room_scarcity_boundary.measure: record_count times nominal_minutes divided equally across compatible rooms
